module: Top-down camera (disabled by default), presented in the code as "an example of a custom camera mode". Follows the vehicle from above with look-ahead toward the actual direction of travel (up to 10 m), smooths position and heading. Options: alignToCar (the top of the screen follows the vehicle's heading instead of north +Y), tilt (0 to 80 degrees from vertical; 45 + ortho = isometric), ortho (orthographic projection, data.res.ortho). Camera distance = 50 + 0.9 * smoothed speed. Default FOV 20. Returns a constructor.
notes: A minimal mode to copy to create your own camera: update must fill data.res.pos (vec3), data.res.rot (quat), data.res.fov, and may fill targetPos; return true.

init calls `C:onVehicleCameraConfigChanged()` (with the class C, not self): the default FOV is therefore written to the class C and not to the instance, which only works because self.fov falls back to C.fov through the metatable (inferred from code).

C.desc: Top-down mode. Fields: alignToCar, tilt, ortho, fov, refNodes.

init.desc: Creates the smoothers and default values.

update.desc: Computes the pose from speed and heading, writes data.res (pos, rot, fov, targetPos, ortho).

setRefNodes.desc: Sets the vehicle's reference nodes (used for alignToCar).

serialize.desc: State for video stream views: alignToCar, fov, tilt, ortho.

listParams.desc: UI settings: align, tilt (0-80), ortho, fov (10-140).

setParam.desc: Changes align, tilt, ortho or fov.
